title: Approval result
description: An Approval's result (FR-11, FR-18, approval-scale-ranking design decision 1): the user's verdict, one of approve, approve-with-changes or reject, and nothing else. The reason travels as the answer's note, never here; what the answer must hold beside a verdict is a check of the type (design decision 2). Never empty: the decision is required. In no schema set until approval-scale-ranking registers it.
